The main takeaway from our work is that
Antarctic notothens have undergone a large degree of cis-regulatory divergence in the promoter regions of chaperone gene loci.
Antarctic notothens exhibit a high degree of cis-regulatory turnover at chaperone genes, which may have facilitated the evolution of frontloaded gene expression in these fishes.
